text: Pogačar arrives with momentum but carries a heavy target: two years ago he bonked spectacularly on Puy Mary and got caught by Vingegaard on the final Cat 1, a script that's about to repeat with identical climbs waiting. Seven categorized ascents and 3,800m of elevation will shred even the strongest legs, but the real danger lies in the accumulation—each climb before Puy Mary is a chance for Vingegaard's team to orchestrate their attack and test whether Pogačar can avoid that same catastrophic fade. Ayuso lurks only 46 seconds back and has the legs of a younger man, while Evenepoel's Red Bull team has shown willingness to race aggressively; if Pogačar falters, the entire podium tilts.
